title: 2D Isometric city-buidling game with RTS and Grand Strategy Game mechanic, with a catch!
author: Ratio_taken
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/ez1km6ph1bxh1.png

https://i.redd.it/wdvpsf7z1bxh1.png

Hi, it's always been a dream of mine of have a game that mixes RTS, Grand Strategy shenanigans and tower defense plus trading, economy, real production chains, gameplay that makes sense in a way you feel connected. With events, riots, protests, demands, law & institutions.   
I've been playing these games all my life; but not to not bore you; there's one that's missing for my soul and I've been tinkering and building it myself.  
  
There are some gaps, graphics missing, mechanics is what it was the point for now.  
  
The catch is that every family is given a trait, which guides it towards its goals. Some may be wants to be workers, some may want to be rulers, some may want to be merchants, patricians or simple hunters, some will make laws.  
  
All while defending from barbarian raids, with real RTS mechanics, guided by you but my goal is to achieve a more realistic of a medieval city. Raiders were the normal.

  
There's trade, unlocked later on, there's merchants, caravans, boats, claims, trading posts. 

But for now, is satisfying too much to expand into KOH type game.
